def st():
    f=current_frame; bs={}; pal={}

            if min(rs)<50: bs[n['color']]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))

    lines=f.ascii.splitlines()
    beam=[c for r in range(17,25) for c in range(17,47) if lines[r][c] in 'wg']
    bs['beam']=(min(beam),max(beam)) if beam else None
    return bs,pal
for a in ['RIGHT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT']:
    action([a])
    bs,pal=st()
    print('after',a,': R',bs['R'][2:],'N',bs['N'][2:],'b',bs['b'][2:],'beam',bs['beam'],'palN',pal.get('N'),'palb',pal.get('b'),{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in('no_impact','level_completed','done','score')})
</parameter>
</function>
